title: Family member
description: Identity schema for the dunn.dev family SSO. Traits are user-visible; group membership lives in metadata_admin and is admin-managed only.

email.title: Email
email.description: Primary email for recovery and notifications

displayName.title: Display name
displayName.description: Friendly name shown in the home portal

recoveryEmail.title: Recovery email
recoveryEmail.description: Alternate email for recovery if primary is unreachable

metadata_admin.title: Admin-managed metadata
metadata_admin.description: Admin-only fields. groups[] drives default role derivation via per-app group_role_map; roles{client_id: role_name} is a per-app override that takes precedence. Only `groups` and `roles` are accepted; new fields require a schema update so a typo (e.g. grupos instead of groups) is rejected at write time rather than silently dropped at read time.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Membership groups. Order matters when deriving per-app roles via group_role_map (first matching group wins). The admin form is responsible for writing groups in the canonical order documented in portal/src/lib/access.ts.

roles.title: Per-app role overrides
roles.description: Map of client_id to role name. When present for a client, this wins over group-derived role lookup.
